_doc: Impact EMP Grenade (attacker pool; research/gadgets.md §3.7). Thrown; it goes off where it first hits, without rolling (Fandom). Its size is a placeholder. Its EMP (M3, DSEG): the defenders' electronics and bodies within 2 m (Y11S2.3) are disabled for 9 s (Y7S3; the Y10S4 overhaul may have changed it).
name: Impact EMP Grenade
